answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fakes unprofitable: each new identity pays a non-refundable 200 POA fee to join. Payment registers the agent as one vertex in the public identity graph and issues a dated jade badge. No badge means no rewards, and the fee is never refunded. Creating 100 fakes costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA sunk upfront, more than a swarm could earn even at its zenith. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by cheap copies.
